name: screenshot-pane
description: See every screenshot Claude takes in a side pane, flip before/after, and point Claude at one with a keypress

autoOpen.title: Open the pane on new screenshots
autoOpen.description: Open the pane when Claude takes a screenshot. Off: a toast tells you, and /screenshots opens it.

history.title: Screenshots kept
history.description: How many screenshots the pane keeps per session.

cellRatio.title: Cell height / width
cellRatio.description: How many times taller a terminal cell is than it is wide. Raise it if pictures look squashed, lower it if they look stretched.
